regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative tape: Banks (512800.SS) dominate on rank, durability (0.8), full breadth (1.0), and trend-health, but are crowded (z=1.84) and the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so the only validated edge — drawdown control — is absent here. Cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0 and rotation-timing is display-only, so this is a focus/liquidity map, not an alpha map; I hold zero directional conviction from the detector itself.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole eligible, trend-confirmed, fully-cohesive narrative (hurts_tag=trend, breadth=1.0, durability_bar=0.8 well above the 0.5 threshold). With only 2 of 22 themes eligible (frac=0.09) and one_narrative=true, leadership is concentrated and not yet showing a confirmed handoff. Crowding (z=1.84) is a size-down caution, not a fade. Because gate_helps=false on this market, this is a conviction-low continuation lean: trend discipline itself has no drawdown-protection backtest here.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded and this market mean-reverts: the trend gate historically whipsaws on A-shares, so the ranking's top theme often marks the exhaustion point rather than continuation; the 1.84 crowding z is the highest in the table.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms CSI 300 by more than 4% over a 3-week lookback before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme (score 0.965), giving it detector attention, but its durability_bar=0.5 sits exactly at the threshold and, critically, hurst_tag=mean-revert — the detector itself flags it as a mean-reverting tape, not a trend. Breadth is a middling 0.4 and crowding is neutral (0.68). This is an avoid-or-underweight lean: failing the trend-health test on a market where the trend gate is unhelpful offers no entry rationale.
theses.dissent: Coal could be the early challenger in a rotation: it is the only other eligible name, absorbs some of the one-narrative flow (absorption=0.33), and mean-reversion could mean it has not yet been chased.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS outperforms CSI 300 by more than 4% while 512800.SS breaks below its 20-day trend before the check-by date.
